description: This file defines the AuthProviderDao class, which handles data access operations related to OpenID authentication providers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting provider entities, utilizing Doctrine ORM query builders and paginator objects.

classes.name: AuthProviderDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing OpenID authentication providers and related entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAuthProviderById
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenIdProvider entity by its ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Fetches additional details for an auth provider given its provider ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns an array of auth providers based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersPaginator
methods.description: Internal method to create a paginator for auth providers with applied filters and sorting.

methods.name: getAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Counts the number of auth providers matching search criteria.

methods.name: deleteProviders
methods.description: Soft deletes providers by setting their status to false based on provided IDs.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Persists a new or updated OpenIdProvider entity.

methods.name: saveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Persists detailed auth provider extra details.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Retrieves all active OpenIdProviders for display on the login page.
